resources.string: Understand the AI world in 3 minutes a day
AI reads the day\'s news for you
8 quality sources are fetched ahead of time by the data pipeline with Chinese digests — open and read, no waiting
Content updates in batches, not real-time
Content ships on a daily schedule (morning/evening editions); a pull-to-refresh saying \"Up to date · Morning edition\" means you\'ve seen this edition
A reader that stays out of your way
The built-in reader supports reader mode, AI page translation and resume reading; tap Save while reading to keep it for later
Tap the active tab again to scroll to top and refresh; long-press to reorder sources on the Sources page
